question: Who among the following won the 2020 Tour de France?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Tadej Pogacar__**.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Point__**

 
• **Tour de France** is an **annual men’s cycling event held for 21-day long stages** over a period of 23 days.
 
• It has **21 stages **and the **longest stage stretches for a distance of 218km.**
 
• It is known for as the** world’s most prestigious** but also the most challenging cycle race.
 
• Tadej Pogacar won the** 2020 Tour de France.**
 
• **Tadej Pogacar (UAE Team Emirates) **sailed in to claim the overall victory in the 2020 Tour de France on the final** stage to Paris.**
 
• Primoz Roglic (Jumbo-Visma), who led the race until the stage 20 time trial, and Richie Porte (Trek-Segafredo) rounded out the podium.
